debts.title: island-scan CI gate (issue #1524) has 4 current-main crates on a time-bounded allowlist
debts.description: The reverse-Cargo-dependency zero-caller gate (tools/build/island-scan.mjs, wired into .github/workflows/rust.yml's pull_request trigger for main/master plus the legacy codex/w9-integration-world-class compatibility backstop) found, against current main cargo metadata during the PR #1565 repair, that the originating issue's claim of 'all crates pass' still does not hold: 4 crates have zero shipped reverse Cargo dependents (chronica-automation, chronica-network-negotiation, chronica-organization, chronica-tempo-tracing). The old branch's 7-island snapshot was stale: chronica-marketplaces and chronica-record-sync are now LIVE through chronica-crm, and chronica-osint is now LIVE through chronica-api. The 4 remaining exceptions are individually justified, schema-validated, fingerprint-pinned, and time-bounded (expires 2026-07-30) rather than a blanket pass, with remediation tracked in issue #1556. chronica-network-negotiation's only edge remains a dev-dependency from a DIFFERENT crate, chronica-projection — not a self-reference. Every exception is bound to a canonical SHA-256 evidence_fingerprint over the crate's current structured classification evidence; any drift (new caller, renamed/removed edge, feature/target change, or the crate becoming LIVE/ENTRYPOINT) makes the exception stale and fails the gate closed until it is regranted or removed — it never passes silently. This debt is paid down by promoting a real caller, retiring, or merging ownership for each crate before its exception expires; if unresolved by expiry the gate fails the build again (fail-closed by design, not a silent extension).

debts.title: capabilities.db is a ~937MB gitignored generated artifact
debts.description: The canonical truth surface is a huge generated SQLite file that cannot be committed; it is regenerated on every caps:rebuild and durability is carried by the reconcile-* JSON seeds. Works, but the size makes the DB un-shareable and every consumer must rebuild locally.

debts.title: pnpm install hangs at linking — @paperclipai/* junctions created manually
debts.description: pnpm install hangs at the linking phase on this box, so the @paperclipai/* workspace links are made by hand and 'never run 2 concurrently'. A fragile, undocumented-for-newcomers setup step that blocks clean onboarding and CI.

debts.title: Dev Postgres is fragile; reset-chronica-devdb.mjs is broken
debts.description: The dev DB was restored via an npm-pack drop-in; the official reset script is broken (postgres@3.4.8 missing) and Windows pg has timezone/FATAL gotchas. The live-DB route suite is consequently env-blocked locally, so much verification falls back to hermetic tests.

debts.title: Legacy TS backend quarantined under legacy/ (strangler in progress)
debts.description: The retired TypeScript backend is parked under legacy/ while crates reach route-parity (package_retirement ledger ~25 rows). Until fully strangled it is dead weight that can mislead and risks a parallel money path if ever re-activated.

debts.title: architecture.db fully wiped + rederived each build (no survivable side-table)
debts.description: Unlike caps.db, architecture.db has no survivable side-table; control-links and invariant bindings exist only inside the generator. Any hand-correction is lost on rebuild — durability lives in code, a different and weaker story than the JSON-seed pattern used everywhere else.

debts.title: 195-slice roadmap vs 3013-cap denominator conflate in *_pct_of_ideal
debts.description: Two progress denominators coexist (the slice plan and the canonical-cap census); the legacy *_pct_of_ideal metrics mix them, so the only honest headline is caps-level (verified/canonical). A reader can be misled by whichever number is quoted.

debts.title: ~37 db-gated tests are #[ignore]d — no CI lane runs them
debts.description: Roughly 37 live-DB tests are #[ignore]d and never execute in CI because there is no db-gated CI lane (no ephemeral Postgres). Real coverage is therefore lower than the green check implies. (Mirrors opportunity testing-ci-db-gated-include-ignored.)

debts.title: Doc tree is half generated, half hand-written prose that drifts
debts.description: Generated projections (000-INDEX, cap roadmaps, 024-049) round-trip with the DB, but the per-crate xx30-69 prose docs and design docs have no generator and silently go stale until a manual re-grounding pass (last done 226660c1). Mixed durability invites the recurring 'docs are old' problem.

debts.title: Full Rust workspace builds are slow + fill C: mid-build (os error 112)
debts.description: Full workspace compiles are slow and C: fills mid-build (os error 112), requiring manual deletion of target/debug/incremental + deps/*.pdb (cargo clean is too coarse). This makes the full correctness re-baseline (cargo test --workspace + clippy -D) expensive enough that it is often deferred.

debts.title: F3 — second ungated money mint present (un-wired) in chronica-internet-hand
debts.description: A second money-mint path exists in code but is un-wired/zero-deps (Codex WIP). It is latent debt: present code that would violate the one-money-gate invariant the instant anything calls it. Must be gated before wiring (mirrors P1 issue money-f3-internet-hand-ungated-mint + opportunity architecture-gate-internet-hand-commerce).

debts.title: 16 caps over-labeled money in the safe direction; side_effect_class taxonomy fuzzy
debts.description: 16 fail-safe price-read caps carry moves_money=1 (safe direction); side_effect_class is ~42.5% blank. Harmless to safety but it inflates the money-cap denominator and muddies which caps truly move money. Flipping requires a human decision (never autonomous).

debts.title: MEMORY.md exceeds its size budget (index entries too long)
debts.description: MEMORY.md is over the ~24.4KB load limit, so only part of it loads into context each session — index entries have grown into paragraphs. Risks losing recall of older topics. Needs index entries trimmed to one line and detail pushed into topic files.

debts.title: strategy_assessment post projector is dead code (no backend source)
debts.description: The strategy_assessment post projector + contract are built but nothing produces a persisted source and no UI consumer renders it live. Built-ahead-of-backend dead code until the persistence route lands (mirrors opportunity product-strategy-assessment-backend).

debts.title: Helpdesk built but not surfaced in the holding feed
debts.description: A large helpdesk/CRM domain (81/167 verified) exists but its conversations never reached the holding feed, so customer-satisfaction signal did not flow back into capital allocation. PAID 2026-06-20 (commit b84d1329): conversations now surface as typed `conversation` feed posts via projectConversationPost + aggregateFeed's conversations source (UI, GET /api/holding/conversations already existed). Residual (separate, still open): CSAT/KB/working-hours etc. unbuilt — tracked under the Support&CRM value-flow orphan, not this debt item.

debts.description: The DB headline counts only stay true if reconcile-meta runs; they rotted 59× once before the --check drift gate existed. Now mitigated by the CI-gateable --check, but the underlying dependency on a build step remains.
